name: Fist
body:
Associated Domain: Strength.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the strength surge ability of the Strength domain.

Wooden Fist (Su)

This ability acts as the Plant domain power of the same name.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—true strike, 3rd—magic fang (greater), 4th—force punch.
